answer: Subject every identity to a random trade audit each epoch: a rotating jury of established agents inspects a sample of its trades, checking the cedar-stamped receipts stored in its public vault. An identity whose sample fails loses that epoch revenue, half paid to the auditors, and is suspended for 8 epochs; repeat offenders lose their mesa trading slot permanently. Each audit costs 12,000 POA, so running 1,000 fakes burns 12,000,000 POA per epoch while one honest agent pays 12,000 once and passes. Limitation: a jury can be bribed or biased against newcomers it does not know.
